{{Quote|Subject wanted by Hutt crime syndicates for reasons unknown.|And-Yees' bounty brief|<ref name="Prima" />}}
'''And-Yees''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Prima" /> They had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange skin. A rogue [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], And-Yees was affiliated with [[Arms dealer/Legends|weapons dealers]] and fellow assassins.<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> And-Yees had become wanted by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime syndicates for reasons unknown to the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]]. The security force placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Gran, claiming they were last located at<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale3|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 3}}</ref> [[Gromas/Legends|Gromas]], and offering 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for their capture or 750 upon And-Yees' [[Death/Legends|death]]. They wore a gray [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] over a red [[shirt]] with tan [[Clothing/Legends|pants]] and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Prima" />

In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> And-Yees was present on [[Outland Transit Station]] and worked for the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]]. On the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was in pursuit of Ghintee when And-Yees fired upon Fett using a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Prima" />

{{GameMechanics}}
Jango Fett captured And-Yees alive for the full sum of credits.<ref name="BH" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
And-Yees first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, And-Yees is the second optional secondary bounty that the player can capture in the mission "Merchant Row" and is the eighth overall. The Gran is able to be captured by the player for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that And-Yees was captured alive for the full sum of credits.
